capabilities: Create dynamic folders that auto-list notes by tag, vault folder, name, or property rules
Nest dynamic folders so children filter their parent's results
Attach folder notes to custom folders and core bookmark groups
Show notes from a specific view in a Bases .base file
Sort and drag bookmarks, and filter the sidebar with search
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Uses private Obsidian APIs, so updates may break it, and testing on desktop and mobile (including touch dragging) is still pending. Base views require Bases enabled and native query support; with core Bookmarks disabled, saved bookmarks are read-only.
intentEvidence: Advanced Bookmarks expands core Bookmarks plugin with dynamic folders and folder notes.
problem: Core Bookmarks only shows manually saved, static bookmarks and cannot automatically group notes by tag, folder, name, or property.

relations.evidence: Advanced Bookmarks expands core Bookmarks plugin with dynamic folders and folder notes.

summary: Bookmarks sidebar replacement that adds dynamic rule-based folders, nested folders, folder notes, Base views, and sorting options.
